notes.title: Bug fix + a surprise:
notes.content:
Bug fix + a surprise:
- The signs on the map had disappeared, they are back
- Under certain conditions you could lose 2 lives instead of one, fixed
- Under certain conditions dying made you quit the game, fixed
- Overusing mushrooms could pause the game, fixed

+ a surprise somewhere

Thanks to the feedback from players, don't hesitate to let me know if you find other bugs, it's hard to predict everything by creating the game alone.
